newsitem.title: USA: Barney's seeks to end license pact with Isetan.
newsitem.headline: Barney's seeks to end license pact with Isetan.

text.p: Barney's Inc said on Thursday it was seeking to terminate its license agreements with Barney's Japan, a subsidiary of Isetan Co Ltd, and is also seeking to void certain Isetan security interests in Barney's.
The retailer, which is in Chapter 11 bankruptcy, said it filed a demand with the American Arbitration Association seeking the termination of its license agreements.
Barney's said it aimed to prohibit Isetan from using the Barneys New York trademark and that it wanted $60 million for operating and payment breaches.
Bill Cox, an Isetan spokesman, told Reuters: "We will have no comment until we've seen...what they've filed."
